questions.q: Which of the following is the chemical formula for common table salt?
questions.x: NaCl (Sodium Chloride) is the chemical name for common table salt.

questions.q: What is the pH value of a neutral solution?
questions.x: A pH value of 7 indicates a neutral solution, like pure water.

questions.q: Which gas is produced when zinc reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid?
questions.x: Zinc reacts with hydrochloric acid to produce hydrogen gas and zinc chloride.

questions.q: What is the valency of carbon in most of its compounds?
questions.x: Carbon typically has a valency of 4, forming four covalent bonds in most compounds.

questions.q: Which of these is a noble gas?
questions.x: Helium is a noble gas, known for its lack of reactivity due to a full valence shell.

questions.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.x: The chemical symbol for gold is derived from its Latin name, *Aurum*, abbreviated as Au.

questions.q: Which acid is present in vinegar?
questions.x: Vinegar primarily contains acetic acid, which gives it its sour taste.

questions.q: Which of the following is a non-metal that conducts electricity?
questions.x: Graphite, an allotrope of carbon, is a non-metal that conducts electricity due to its free electrons.
Alexander Graham Bell patented the telephone in 1876, though others like Edison also worked on similar devices.

questions.q: The X-ray was discovered by which scientist?
questions.x: Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays in 1895 while experimenting with cathode rays, earning him the first Nobel Prize in Physics.

questions.q: Who discovered the law of gravitation?
questions.x: Isaac Newton formulated the law of universal gravitation in 1687, explaining planetary motion and gravity.

questions.q: The process of pasteurization is named after which scientist?
questions.x: Louis Pasteur developed pasteurization in the 1860s to prevent spoilage and disease in food and beverages.

questions.q: Who invented the World Wide Web?
questions.x: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989 while working at CERN, creating protocols like HTML and HTTP.
Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928, the first widely used antibiotic, by observing bacterial growth inhibition.

questions.q: Who developed the theory of evolution by natural selection?
questions.x: Charles Darwin published *On the Origin of Species* in 1859, detailing his theory of evolution by natural selection.

questions.q: The first successful vaccine was developed against which disease?
questions.x: Edward Jenner developed the first vaccine in 1796 against smallpox using cowpox virus.
